materials.vertexShader:
attribute vec3 end; attribute vec2 corner; attribute vec3 normalA; attribute vec3 normalB; attribute float boundary; uniform vec2 resolution; uniform float width; varying float visibleEdge;
      void main(){vec4 av=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0),bv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(end,1.0);vec4 a=projectionMatrix*av,b=projectionMatrix*bv;vec2 d=(b.xy/b.w-a.xy/a.w)*resolution;float len=length(d);vec2 perpendicular=vec2(-d.y,d.x)/max(len,0.0001);vec4 p=mix(a,b,corner.x);p.xy+=perpendicular*corner.y*width/resolution*p.w;p.z-=0.000001*p.w;gl_Position=p;float f=dot(normalMatrix*normalA,-av.xyz)*dot(normalMatrix*normalB,-av.xyz);visibleEdge=max(boundary,f<=0.0?1.0:0.0);}
materials.fragmentShader: uniform vec3 ink;uniform float opacity;varying float visibleEdge;void main(){if(visibleEdge<0.5)discard;gl_FragColor=vec4(ink,opacity);}
